tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, and the inset ground of cards nested inside a surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, columns, question cards and dialogs that sit on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, question stems and body copy on bg, surface and every *-subtle fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on bg and surface: descriptions, metadata, column labels, timestamps.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between and around panels and cards. Below 3:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: answer options, inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, the selected answer before it is checked, progress, tags. Readable as text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button). Dark in the dark theme because accent lightens there.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with a 2px offset on every interactive element. At least 5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Correct-answer state: border, icon and the word "Correct" on surface, bg and correct-subtle. Always paired with an icon and a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: correct-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind a correct answer option or a correct-result banner. Text on it stays text.

tokens.name: incorrect
tokens.usage: Incorrect-answer state: border, icon and the word "Incorrect" on surface, bg and incorrect-subtle. An orange, not a red, and always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: incorrect-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind the option the learner chose when it was wrong.

tokens.name: marked
tokens.usage: Marked-for-review flag: icon, label and border on surface, bg and marked-subtle.

tokens.name: marked-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind a marked question in lists and the review queue.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page or exam title.

styles.name: question
styles.sample: Which service stores objects with eleven nines of durability?
styles.usage: Question stems and answer text during practice and mock exams; the larger size is for long reading sessions.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Review missed or marked questions on a schedule.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Find questions by topic, exam and status.
styles.usage: Card descriptions and metadata, in muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase column and group labels, in muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside tags and between a label and its control; tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between stacked answer options.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gap between columns, page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding; space between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, answer options, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and board columns that hold cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, badges and progress tracks.
